name: TenWords
tagline: Every paragraph in exactly ten words
voice: A printed page, not a screen: paper-white light surfaces (#fbfbfb, never dark mode), near-black ink, hairline rules, serif typography with italic captions and small tracked uppercase headers. THE PILCROW RULE: accent red #9c2f26 belongs to the pilcrow mark and small accents only, never a wash, never a large fill, never gradient text, zero glow or bloom because print does not glow. The signature motion is the collapse: long text folds away and ten words remain, paragraph after paragraph with a quiet stagger; restore brings it all back. The register is exact and calm; the number ten is always literal, enforced in code, never approximate. Rejects AI hype and dashboard chrome. Copy: no em dashes, no hype words, verbs like condense, skim, restore.
